description: Defines the NoteEditorViewModel class responsible for managing UI state and operations (create, update, delete) for note editing in an Android application, including data flows and repository interactions.

classes.name: NoteEditorUiState
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the UI state for the note editor, primarily holding an optional Note object.

classes.name: NoteEditorViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing the presentation logic for editing notes, including observing note data and performing save/delete operations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new note or updates an existing one, trimming input text, and invokes an onDone callback upon completion.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the current note if it exists and calls the provided onDone lambda.
